extracted.name: Kadi gosh
ingredient_lines: Boneless chicken: 500 gram cut in 1 inch
2 Tsp Ginger garlic paste – (adrek lasan paste)
instruction_lines: Marinate chicken, Add lemon, Add ginger garlic paste, Add spices, Add grinded masala, Mix well.

Marinate 15-20mins, Go through the preparation, shown below, Let’s fry now, Take a pan to add oil keep on med heat, Deep chicken in beaten egg drop chicken stick one by one, Fry till turn golden brown, Flip it, Both sides fried well, Chicken stick ready to serve.
